about: Astral Limited engages in the manufacture and marketing of pipes and fittings, water tanks, and adhesives and sealants in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Plumbing, and Paints and Adhesives. It offers plumbing pipes and fittings, sewerage and drainage pipes and fittings, agriculture pipes and fittings, cable protection system, industrial piping system, fire protection system, urban infrastructure, ancillary products, and column pipe; and roto moulding, blow moulde
